title: Deferred ingestion-owner handoff: ASTRA Operations atomic port and workflow dispatch eligibility
body:
## Ownership and scheduling
**Handoff only; do not interrupt active ingestion repair.** This issue is for the existing ingestion controller at https://chatgpt.com/c/6ae206a6-9524-83ed-b103-7c23bcfe51e5. ASTRA Operations MCP is a client capability owner, **not** a replacement ingestion controller. Do not start work from this issue without the ingestion owner's current admission/release gates and stop/fence reconciliation.

## Verified read-only source findings (2026-10-30)
- Current ingestion implementation branch `feat/astra-ingestion-service`, observed head `08bea176e39174f8c39f62caebae79d5cb50cdcf`.
- `astra_ingestion/api.py` (blob `23571883acd35dcab295f9486e993619003d69a8`) exposes authenticated GET `/api/jobs`, `/api/jobs/{id}`, `/api/backfill/status`; POST `/api/jobs` with Idempotency-Key and POST `/api/jobs/{id}/pause|resume|cancel`. **Existing Basic identity is control-capable** and must not be shared with Sites.
- `astra_ingestion/rpc_store.py` (blob `b423c9cb6ca0adcdece631d12b36e00149dd5b1a`) maps `health/list_jobs/get_job/submit_job/control_job/claim_next/reserve_request/commit_page/...` to fenced ingestion RPC. It does not expose the four ASTRA Operations owner-port operations.
- `sql/astra_ingestion_rpc_v1.sql` (blob `9cb1d522a8fab6660c1cbebd951dd4df7871da03`) implements per-job idempotency, partition owner/generation/lease and pause/cancel fencing, **not a verified cross-provider immutable-change reservation/physical-resource lock/causal write readback port** for Render and GitHub.
- `sql/astra_ingestion_bulk_provider_atomic_receipt_v1.sql` has provider-page atomic receipt/readback for ingestion; this is **not equivalent** to a Render service change or GitHub workflow dispatch receipt.
- Qualification workflow `.github/workflows/astra-ingestion-qualification.yml` exists on implementation branch but **does not declare `workflow_dispatch`**. The file is absent at the same path on `main` (404), so no default-branch dispatch eligibility is established.
- Render worker `srv-dbh9fko473hc739an8m0` already exists; do not create duplicate. Free Render worker creation is unsupported; no new paid service approved.

## Controller-owner decision/implementation requested (deferred)
1. Identify an **existing** controller durable outcome store, immutable admission and owner stop/fence/lease/physical resource locking interface that could safely serve `lookupExact/admitExact/reserveAndDispatchUnderOwnerGuard/readbackExact`. If no suitable interface exists, report the exact missing owner capability; do not adopt N1's second journal/controller.
2. For any proposed extension, qualify owner-atomic reservation under 20 concurrent requests, alternate idempotency keys/revisions, stop/owner/fence changes, PREPARED/DISPATCHING crash windows, UNKNOWN no-replay, and provider-causal readback. See v11 `OWNER_PORT_ADOPTION_CONTRACT.md` and checkpoint at `engineering/astra-operations-mcp/sites-v11/CONTROLLER_OWNER_PORT_QUALIFICATION.md`.
3. Decide whether manual `workflow_dispatch` is useful for the existing ingestion qualification workflow. If yes, qualify a change **through the ingestion owner's own branch/release process** including default-branch workflow presence; do not add a trigger here.
4. Define controller-owned GET-only identity/facade for ingestion status (no POST authority) if appropriate; do not transfer existing Basic credentials.

## Non-goals and gates
No production write, workflow modification, provider credential/grant, GitHub App installation, Render key creation, Site release, PR approval, spending, scanner operation or trade is authorised by this issue. Dot coordinates specific action-time confirmations only after account/provider identity, effective permissions, secure destination, expiry/revocation and operational/cost effects are established.

## Response requested
Owner's source-backed interface mapping or precise gap; the smallest admitted next action; and whether/when it can be scheduled without interrupting current repair. The ASTRA Operations owner will adapt the MCP client only after owner evidence and authorisation.
